name: Petalburg City
lines:
I’m not going to take it easy just
because you’re our Leader’s kid.
I’ll show you how horrible it is for
a Pokémon to take a critical hit!

Your father really is strong.
He’s a Trainer worthy of respect.
And I sense the same brilliance
in you as in your father.
I hope you’ll stage a terrific
battle between father and sondaughter!

The Trainers of Petalburg City have become a
lot tougher since your father became Leader.
